import json,subprocess,hashlib,re,csv,io
from pathlib import Path
repo=Path('/workspace/e02-B-current-durability')
p='policy-engine/docs/research/e02-cloud-test-plan/implementation-handoffs/B/current-all60-source-only-candidate-map.json'
d=json.loads((repo/p).read_text()); root=d['root_source_cut']['sha']; canonical=d['canonical_source_basis']['git_sha']
def blob(ref,path): return subprocess.check_output(['git','show',ref+':'+path],cwd=repo)
ids={r['finding_id'] for r in csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(blob(root,'policy-engine/docs/research/e02-cloud-test-plan/execution-organization/finding-owners.tsv').decode()),delimiter='\t') if r['unit']=='B'}
assert ids=={r['finding_id'] for r in d['rows']} and len(ids)==len(d['rows'])==60
cards={}
for r in d['rows']:
 path=d['canonical_source_basis']['card_path_template'].format(bundle_id=r['bundle_id'])
 cards[path]=blob(canonical,path); assert cards[path]==blob(root,path)
 match=re.search(r'<!-- SOURCE_BEGIN [^ ]+:'+re.escape(r['finding_id'])+r' -->(.*?)<!-- SOURCE_END [^ ]+:'+re.escape(r['finding_id'])+r' -->',cards[path].decode(),re.S)
 assert match and hashlib.sha256(match.group(1).encode()).hexdigest()==r['canonical_criterion']['source_block_sha256']
assert len(cards)==len(d['scope_profiles'])==25
for name,v in d['basis_index'].items():
 raw=blob(v.get('git_sha',v.get('sha')),v['path'])
 assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==v['sha256'] and len(raw)==v['bytes'],name
assert d['closure_ids']==[] and d['current_final_native_case_join'] is None
assert all('finding_status_proposal' not in r and 'technical_property_proposal' not in r for r in d['rows'])
print(json.dumps({'owner_ids':60,'cards':25,'criterion_digest_matches':60,'basis_git_objects':len(d['basis_index']),'no_status_upgrade_fields':True,'closure_ids':[],'runtime_case_join':'WAIT'}))
